name: Auto-login failing for a secret
query: sum(last_2h):(clamp_max(clamp_min(sum:secrets.autologin.attempt{!forge_cluster:plat-sandbox,outcome:failure} by {env,secretname}.as_count() - 3, 0), 1) + 0 * (sum:secrets.autologin.attempt{!forge_cluster:plat-sandbox,outcome:failure} by {env,secretname}.as_count() - 3)) * (clamp_max(clamp_min(100 * sum:secrets.autologin.attempt{!forge_cluster:plat-sandbox,outcome:failure} by {env,secretname}.as_count() - 80 * sum:secrets.autologin.attempt{!forge_cluster:plat-sandbox} by {env,secretname}.as_count() + 1, 0), 1) + 0 * (100 * sum:secrets.autologin.attempt{!forge_cluster:plat-sandbox,outcome:failure} by {env,secretname}.as_count() - 80 * sum:secrets.autologin.attempt{!forge_cluster:plat-sandbox} by {env,secretname}.as_count() + 1)) >= 1
